gen-fs-expose-gf-athiti: Striking and tightly packed, Expose crowds its capitals close to the lowercase with barely a breath between letters. Athiti runs a single line width through every curve, so a longer stretch of text moves along friendly and unfussed.
gen-fs-expose-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible has clipped capitals and ascenders, with wide-set terminals on its s. Expose rushes along in a compressed, refined line, and the text beneath slows everything down to a friendly pace.
gen-fs-expose-gf-cascadia-code: Expose leaves almost no gap between its capitals and its lowercase height. Cascadia Code is a wire-like monoline with generous spacing between neighbors and a smooth, unobstructed path around every bend.
gen-fs-expose-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Expose is striking and refined, packed into a compressed cadence. Expose does its best work in tight, polished lines; Chocolate Classical Sans does its best with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke.
gen-fs-expose-gf-cossette-texte: Refined and compressed, Expose leaves almost no gap between capitals and lowercase. Down the page, Cossette Texte reads clean and unhurried, its wide-eyed e and prominent x-height carrying each line.
gen-fs-expose-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans lets its open-mouthed small letters dominate the line while ascenders hardly show, beneath a compressed Expose headline. Paragraphs flow smoothly, clean and modern, with no spiky interruptions.
gen-fs-expose-gf-fresca: Striking and refined, Expose compresses its capitals right up against the lowercase. Fresca, with its connected apertures and short ascenders above big bowls, reads modern and clean over a full page of text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady and opens its lowercase e like a pried clasp. And where Expose excels at compressed, striking display lines, Funnel Sans excels at steady, clean text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-gafata: Hardly any gap separates the capitals from the lowercase in Expose, giving it a compressed cadence. But where Expose shows off, Gafata works, setting a tall band of letters with short stalks and wide-eyed e's.
gen-fs-expose-gf-geist: Geist holds a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, a steady foil for the compressed Expose. Words settle into solid blocks rather than skylines, paragraph after clean paragraph.
